title: Default/weak credential & exposure checks (safe)
description: Check for common exposures without lockout/damage.
detail: Authorized only, rate-limit to avoid lockouts. 1) Look for default creds on mgmt interfaces (from vendor docs) - try minimal, controlled attempts if allowed. 2) Check anonymous/guest access (SMB/FTP/LDAP/Redis/Mongo) per scope. 3) Use nuclei default-login/exposure templates carefully; exclude ICS/fragile. 4) Verify manually; record cred/vuln facts with evidence. Never brute-force aggressively on production/OT.
